verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a payments platform that ships client-side SDKs and a local MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out control. Credential scoping, the MCP tool subset flag and API-key handling are adjacent security controls, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.
